in_marathi.name: Anjan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anjan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anjan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'anjana', which means 'delight' or 'joy'. It is also associated with the goddess Anjani, who is the mother of Hanuman. In Hindu mythology, Anjan represents purity, strength, and devotion.
